latencyRatioInterval95.method: percentile bootstrap of median(baseline)/median(candidate); medians resist outliers such as GC pauses

gateReasons: Candidate faster with equal quality, matched environment and an interval that excludes no change
notes: Differences reflect these local benchmark runs, not guaranteed future performance
No electrical power, carbon, or cost saving is inferred from latency alone
Energy, carbon and cost gates are NOT_RUN: no meter or user-supplied model was provided to this comparison
